notes: was in over his host was Nahshon goes to the preposition heading the prepositional predicate under rule 49, the name being the clause's subject and taking only its own word; this pattern recurs at vv.15-16, 18-20, 22-27.
in the first place: the assimilated article takes the written the (rule 12) and the supplied place joins the ordinal's unit while the head stays on first (rule 31).
